game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · Portability
game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Break Out: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
player_objective: Case 10: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about Portability.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Break Out' (Week 4 slot 10), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Dragon Hoard Cave'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification
